Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue. West Triar*, City http: ltwww. diogov.ph 10 SEP DILG OPINION NO. MS. CHRISTINE MAE SARITO Dear Ms. Sarito: S. 2018 This has reference to your Electronic Freedom of Information (eFOl) request dated 28 April 2018 seeking the Department's legal opinion on the effect of City Ordinances, SP Resolutions and other Sangguniang documents signed by a person appointed Secretary to the Sanggunian who, on the decision of the Civil Service Commission is prohibited to perform duties and functions of the said position because of the person's contractual appointment. First and foremost, please be informed that it is not the Sanggunian Secretary who made/passed the ordinance as the same could only be made/passed by the Sangguniang Panlungsod (SP) Members. In the herein query, it appears that the Sanggunian Secretary has a de factotitle over the position. The case of Torres vs. Ribol defined de facto officer as one who has the reputation of the officer that he assumes to be, and yet is not a good officer in point of law. He must have acted as an officer long enough and came to power under a colorable authority or by the acquiescence of the people and local authorities. The actions of a de Æctooffcer are considered to have legal effect and are binding. This is for the protection of people who get involved in the official acts of a person performing the duties of public office. One of the instances to be considered that an office has a colorable title is that there is an appointment that is void because the officer in question is not eligible. But at most, a de facto officer's acts maybe given validity in the eye of the law if they are made within the scope of the authority vested by the law2. Thus, this Department firmly believe that the Sanggunian Secretary's disqualification to hold the position will not affect the validity of the Ordinances, Resolutions and any other documents signed by her. 81 Phil 44 2 Benito Codiffa, et al. vs. Jose L Martinez, et al., G.R. No. L-14569damH 2?

We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: C. SACENDONCILLO Assistant Secretary
